grammar_patterns.explanation: とも as a sentence-final emphatic affirmer is formal/literary ('indeed so, certainly'). 我が is the classical/literary possessive (vs. modern 私の). よ in 友よ is a classical vocative particle used when addressing someone directly with emotion, equivalent to 'O friend' in English poetic register. This line is characteristic of FFT's noble dramatic speech.
